originalRegistration.freshCold: 36 predetermined cases, fixed style/map/own-doctrine cells, balanced original source hosts; replay all four strength arms on BOTH hosts after qualification, 288 cold executions. Source cases are fixed before outcomes and do not add independent strength samples.

fixedProtocol.population: First legal naturally barrel-containing draft pair from 128 pre-reserved disjoint candidates per family. Four fixed opponent draft styles; each has seven complete 27 map/own/opponent-doctrine cycles. Real native paid public Setup, legal splitting and placement; no forced offers, artifacts, picks or spending.
fixedProtocol.primary: Equal-weight whole-family mean entrant score(mixture)-score(stock v10). Scores 0/0.5/1. All four matched cases stay together. Inspect aggregate outcomes only after both hosts complete.

confidence.bootstrap: 20000 uint32 xorshift32 whole-family resamples; independent Bun integer half-point reconstruction

fixedProtocol.secondary: Naive v1 and accepted pair contrasts remain descriptive and cannot substitute for the primary comparator. No multiplicity selection among candidates.
fixedProtocol.assignment: Within each 189-family style block, cycles 0..5 of 27 go local, cycle 6 goes Puffalo. Entire family/all cases/all arms stay on that host. No reassignment after first combat.
fixedProtocol.cold: Before fresh combat, six fixed existing functional cases (indices 0,8,16,24,28,32) reproduce all four arms locally and on Puffalo. Require exact consumed input/full trace/score/forecast counts and witnesses. Fresh cold repeats are selected by fixed style/map/own-doctrine cells before first strength fight.
fixedProtocol.fixedTermination: Freeze a common absolute cutoff before either shard starts, at most 2.5 hours after strength registration. No automatic retry, extension, source/model/gate change, outcome-selected subset or incomplete-bank promotion.
fixedProtocol.progress: Complete case/fight counts and health only while running; no interim score-based decisions.
fixedProtocol.afterPassing: Separately register quiet serial full-fight and complete-decision cost within +10%, then at least 756 independent fresh confirmation families. No cost/confirmation channels allocated here. No automatic serving promotion or deployment from qualification.

preCombatOperationalAmendment.reason: Existing fixed cold controls took 35.053s local and 185.09s Puffalo under its shared CPU workload. Balance complete families before any fresh combat; no source, model, seed, setup, eligibility, arm, score gate or confirmation rule changes.

independentSeedAndInputAudit.priorNonoverlap: Independently allocated Python membership assertion against sealed exclusions; this check reconstructs every reserved/scanned channel using the engine's native permutation.

analysisRegistration.method: Whole-family integer-half-point reconstruction. 20,000 uint32 xorshift resamples, primary seed1746179601; independent Bun reconstruction of all raw outcomes, bootstrap endpoints and fixed gates. Stock/default comparison alone is inferential; all secondary arms descriptive.
analysisRegistration.blind: Do not read fresh aggregate scores before both terminal shards and fixed full-bank quality checks. Progress/health-only monitoring has shown zero timing fallbacks; full-work validity is asserted by both implementations.

note: The 648-local/108-Puffalo split was amended after fixed cold throughput calibration and before first fresh combat; original 540/216 allocation remains preserved. All score gates, seeds, policy and full paired family membership are unchanged. No fresh aggregate result is asserted.
